pages.text: 夏天的早晨，阳光暖暖的。爸爸牵着咘咘的左手，妈妈牵着咘咘的右手，一家人走在去新幼儿园的路上。咘咘穿着粉色小裙子，背着新书包，一蹦一跳地走着。
pages.text_en: On a warm summer morning, Dad held Bubu's left hand and Mom held her right hand as they walked to the new kindergarten together. Bubu wore her pink dress and new backpack, bouncing along happily.

pages.text: 幼儿园门口，一只优雅的白尾鹿笑眯眯地蹲下来，跟咘咘平视。“早上好呀小朋友！我是李老师，欢迎你来我们班！”李老师的声音又轻又柔，像棉花糖一样软。
pages.text_en: At the kindergarten gate, an elegant white-tailed deer squatted down to meet Bubu at eye level, smiling warmly. "Good morning little one! I'm Teacher Li, welcome to our class!" Her voice was soft and gentle, like cotton candy.

pages.text: 咘咘跟爸爸妈妈挥挥手说再见，一点也不害怕。李老师牵着咘咘的小手走进教室，里面已经有好几个小朋友在玩了。
pages.text_en: Bubu waved goodbye to Mom and Dad without any fear. Teacher Li held Bubu's little hand and walked into the classroom, where several other children were already playing.

pages.text: “Good morning, Bubu!”一只红棕色的狐狸笑着走过来，尾巴轻轻摇摆。“I’m Teacher Kate! Do you want to sing a song with me?”Kate老师拿出一把小吉他，开始弹奏。
pages.text_en: "Good morning, Bubu!" A red-brown fox walked over with a smile, her tail swaying gently. "I'm Teacher Kate! Do you want to sing a song with me?" Teacher Kate pulled out a little guitar and began to play.

pages.text: Kate老师教大家唱“Head, shoulders, knees and toes”，小朋友们跟着做动作，咘咘也摸摸自己的头、拍拍肩膀，笑得眼睛弯弯的。
pages.text_en: Teacher Kate taught everyone to sing "Head, shoulders, knees and toes." The children followed along with the moves, and Bubu touched her head and patted her shoulders, laughing with her eyes curved into happy crescents.

pages.text: 手工课的时候，一只灰色的考拉慢慢地走过来，轻声说：“小朋友们，今天我们来画夏天的花。”甘老师把彩色颜料一样一样摆好，温柔地帮咘咘系上小围裙。
pages.text_en: During craft time, a grey koala walked over slowly and said softly, "Children, today we'll paint summer flowers." Teacher Gan carefully laid out colorful paints and gently helped Bubu put on a little apron.

pages.text: 咘咘用小手蘸着颜料，在纸上画了一朵大大的红花。甘老师蹲在旁边，慢慢地说：“画得真好看呀，咘咘的花开得好大。”
pages.text_en: Bubu dipped her little paws in paint and drew a big red flower on paper. Teacher Gan squatted beside her and said slowly, "That's so beautiful, Bubu's flower blooms so big."

pages.text: 一只黑白色的燕子轻盈地飞来飞去，照看着每一个小朋友。燕子老师一会儿帮这个擦鼻子，一会儿帮那个拿杯子喝水，分叉的燕尾在身后灵活地摆动。
pages.text_en: A black-and-white swallow flew lightly around, looking after every child. Teacher Yanzi wiped one child's nose here, helped another get a cup of water there, her forked tail swaying nimbly behind her.

pages.text: 中午吃饭啦！李老师帮咘咘盛了一碗热乎乎的番茄蛋汤。“小心烫哦，吹一吹再喝。”咘咘乖乖地吹了吹，“嗯——好好喝！”
pages.text_en: Lunchtime! Teacher Li ladled a bowl of warm tomato egg soup for Bubu. "Careful, it's hot — blow on it first." Bubu blew gently, then exclaimed, "Mmm — so yummy!"

pages.text: 午睡时间到了。小朋友们躺在小床上，李老师轻轻地拍着咘咘的背，哼着歌。咘咘抱着小兔子枕头，眼皮越来越重，很快就睡着了。
pages.text_en: Nap time arrived. The children lay on their little beds, and Teacher Li gently patted Bubu's back while humming a song. Bubu hugged her bunny pillow, her eyelids growing heavier, and soon fell asleep.

pages.text: 下午，小朋友们在操场上做游戏。咘咘和新朋友们一起滑滑梯、荡秋千。燕子老师在旁边飞着，笑着说：“慢一点哦，小心台阶！”阳光下，大家玩得满头大汗。
pages.text_en: In the afternoon, the children played games on the playground. Bubu slid down slides and swung on swings with her new friends. Teacher Yanzi flew nearby, smiling: "Slow down, watch the steps!" Under the sun, everyone played until they were sweaty and happy.

pages.text: 傍晚，外公外婆来接咘咘啦！咘咘看到他们，开心地跑过去扑进外婆怀里。回到家，咘咘抱着NOMI和NONO，兴奋地说：“新幼儿园好好玩！有鹿老师、狐狸老师、考拉老师，还有会飞的燕子老师！明天还要去！” NOMI和NONO互相看了一眼，开心地笑了。
pages.text_en: In the evening, Grandpa and Grandma came to pick up Bubu! Bubu saw them and ran over happily, jumping into Grandma's arms. Back home, Bubu hugged NOMI and NONO excitedly: "The new kindergarten is so fun! There's a deer teacher, a fox teacher, a koala teacher, and a flying swallow teacher! I want to go again tomorrow!" NOMI and NONO looked at each other and smiled happily.
